title: Periodic solutions of nonlinear control systems with switching: a Lie-algebraic and contraction approach
summary: This paper is devoted to the analysis of periodic solutions of nonlinear control-affine systems with bang-bang controls. Such problems naturally arise in periodic optimal control with constrained inputs, which have, in particular, important applications in the performance optimization of chemical reactions. We reduce the problem of constructing a periodic solution to that of finding a fixed point of a composition of exponential maps.
